raw_text:
Here’s a focused 12-week bodyweight strength program designed for a beginner male (27) training in a small flat with only a yoga mat and a doorway pull-up bar. It builds foundational movement quality first, then progressive strength via lever changes, tempo, volume, and density. Three main sessions per week (A/B/C), plus an optional short “skill/core/conditioning” session. Each session ~40–55 minutes. Warm-up and cool-down included.

Overview
- Frequency: 3 days/week (e.g., Mon/Wed/Fri) + optional 1 short session (Sat/Sun).
- Phases:
  1) Foundation (Weeks 1–3): Technique, joint prep, build basic reps.
  2) Strength Accumulation (Weeks 4–7): Increase difficulty, add volume and tempo.
  3) Strength Intensification (Weeks 8–10): Harder progressions, lower reps, more sets; introduce EMOM/cluster work.
  4) Consolidation & Testing (Weeks 11–12): Solidify gains, test simple strength benchmarks.
- Main movement patterns: Push (horizontal/vertical), Pull (vertical/row variations), Squat/lunge, Hinge, Core (anti-extension/anti-rotation/flexion), Carry equivalents (time-under-tension holds), Posterior chain/glute emphasis.
- Progressions use: Lever (knees → full, decline, archer, pike), tempo (e.g., 3–1–X), pauses, range, unilateral bias, density (same work in less time).
- Rest: 60–120s between sets; longer for tougher pulls/presses.
- Notation: Sets x reps (tempo). Tempo example 3–1–X = 3s down, 1s pause, explosive up.

General Warm-Up (before every session, ~7–10 min)
- 3 min easy mobility flow: neck rolls, shoulder circles, hip circles, ankle rocks.
- Dynamic: inchworms x 5, world’s greatest stretch x 5/side, leg swings x 10/side, scap pull-up shrugs x 8–10, bandless face-pull pattern (squeeze shoulder blades) x 12.
- RAMP sets for first main move: 1–2 easy sets.

Cool-Down (3–5 min)
- Breathing: 2 min nasal 4-4-6-2 (inhale-hold-exhale-hold).
- Light stretches: pec doorway stretch, hip flexor lunge, child’s pose, 30–45s each.

Weekly Structure
- Session A: Horizontal push + squat + core
- Session B: Vertical pull + hinge/posterior chain + core
- Session C: Push-press blend + unilateral lower + anti-rotation
- Optional Skill/Conditioning: Short EMOM or intervals; handstand/pike skill, hangs, and easy conditioning.

Phase 1: Foundation (Weeks 1–3)
Goal: Groove patterns, build base reps, joint resilience, scap control.

Week 1
Session A
- Push-up (incline on couch/bed) 4x6–8 (2–1–2)
- Bodyweight Squat 4x8–10 (2–1–2) with hands overhead if able
- Deadbug 3x8/side (2–1–2)
- Forearm Side Plank 3x20–30s/side
- Hollow Hold 3x15–25s
Finish: 30–60s passive hang from bar (breaks OK)

Session B
- Assisted Pull-up (use chair for foot support) 5x3–5 (3–1–X)
- Hip Hinge Good Morning (hands on hips, soft knees) 4x10–12 (3–1–2)
- Glute Bridge 4x10–12 (2–1–2, 2s squeeze top)
- Reverse Snow Angels on floor 3x8–10
- Deadbug Heel Taps 3x10/side
Finish: Scap Pull-up Shrugs 2x8–10

Session C
- Pike Push-up (hips high, hands shoulder-width) 4x5–7 (3–1–X)
- Split Squat (rear foot on floor) 4x8/side (2–1–2)
- Doorway Row (underhand grip on towel around bar, feet bent) 4x6–8 (2–1–2)
- Pallof Press (kneeling bandless variant: press hands straight out resisting trunk movement) 3x10 slow reps
- Curl-up (McGill) 3x8–10
Finish: Hollow Rock gentle 2x10

Week 2
- Aim +1 rep per set where form allows. Keep same exercises/tempo.
- Add Pause: Squat 1s pause bottom; Glute Bridge 3s squeeze top.
- Hangs: add scap depressions 2x6 during hang on B.

Week 3
- Transition some levers:
  - Push-up: lower the incline slightly or move feet back 4x8–10.
  - Assisted Pull-up: 5x4–6 with slower 3–1–2.
  - Pike Push-up: 4x6–8.
  - Split Squat: 4x9–10/side.
- Core: Hollow Hold 3x20–30s; Side Plank 3x30–40s.

Phase 2: Strength Accumulation (Weeks 4–7)
Goal: Harder progressions, more total volume, introduce tempos/pauses.

Week 4
Session A
- Push-up (flat, hands under shoulders; elevate if needed) 5x6–8 (3–1–X)
- Tempo Squat 5x8 (3–2–1, 2s pause bottom)
- Hollow Body Tuck Rocks 4x12–15
- Side Plank with Hip Abduction 3x10/side
Finisher: Push-up Eccentrics 2x3 (5s down, knees up)

Session B
- Assisted Pull-up 6x3–5 (3–1–X); goal: reduce leg assist slightly each week
- Hip Hinge to Wall 4x12 (slow, feel hamstrings)
- Single-Leg Glute Bridge 4x8–10/side (2–1–2)
- Doorway Row (feet further forward) 4x8–10 (2–1–2)
- Deadbug with Bandless Pulldown (arms overhead) 3x10/side

Session C
- Pike Push-up (elevate feet on couch if able) 5x5–7 (3–1–X)
- Reverse Lunge 4x8–10/side (2–1–2)
- Chin-up Eccentrics 4x3 (jump to top, 5–6s lower)
- Bear Crawl 3x20–30m total
Core: Plank Reach 3x8/side (slow)

Week 5
- Progress reps by 1 where possible or add a set on main move.
- Introduce partial range where stuck: e.g., lower push-up to stacked books and remove one book weekly.
- Pull: Add isometric mid-range holds 2x10–15s on assisted pull-ups.

Week 6
Session A
- Push-up 6x6 (4–1–X) higher tension; if easy: decline 2–4 inches
- Squat to 1.5 reps 4x8 (down, halfway up, down, up = 1)
- Copenhagen Side Plank (knees) 3x12–20s/side
- Hollow to One-Leg Extension 3x10/side

Session B
- Pull-up Cluster (assisted): 5 rounds of 2+2+2 reps, 15–20s breaths between mini-sets, 2–3 min between rounds
- Hip Hinge: Slow Good Morning 4x12 (4–1–2)
- SL Glute Bridge 4x10/side with 2s top hold
- Doorway Row 4x10–12 (3–1–2)

Session C
- Pike Push-up (feet elevated if strong) 5x6 (3–1–X); add 2s bottom pause last rep
- Bulgarian Split Squat (rear foot on couch) 4x8/side (2–1–2)
- Chin-up Eccentrics 5x2 (6–8s down)
- Anti-rotation Press (tall-kneel) 3x12/side

Week 7 (Deload volume by ~20–30% but keep intensity)
- Do 75–80% of sets on each movement, keep tempos. Focus on pristine form.
- Practice active hangs 3x20–30s and scap circles 2x8.

Phase 3: Strength Intensification (Weeks 8–10)
Goal: Heavier progressions, lower reps, more sets, EMOM/cluster, isometrics.

Week 8
Session A
- Decline Push-up (feet on couch) 6x4–6 (3–1–X)
- Squat Isometric: 3x20–30s hold at just above parallel + 3x6 controlled reps after each hold
- Archer Push-up Prep (wide stance hands, shift side-to-side) 3x4–6/side (3–1–X)
- Hollow Body Full 4x20–30s

Session B
- Pull-up Eccentric+Isometric: 5x(1 rep 8s down + 10s hold at 90° elbow) with minimal assist up
- Doorway Row Feet Elevated (heels on couch) 5x6–8 (3–1–X)
- Hip Hinge Hip Airplane (balance/hinge) 3x6/side
- SL Hip Thrust on couch 4x8–10/side (2–2–2)
- Hanging Knee Raise 4x6–8 (2–1–2)

Session C
- Pike HSPU Range Work: Hands on books, head to mat, shallow range 6x3–5 (3–1–X)
- Front-Foot Elevated Split Squat (2–3cm) 4x6–8/side (3–2–1)
- Chin-up Cluster (assisted): 6 rounds of 2–3 reps, 20s intra-set, 2–3 min between
- Anti-rotation Plank (shoulder taps) 3x10–12/side

Week 9
- Push: Add 1–2 reps total per set where possible or increase decline height slightly.
- Pull: Reduce leg assist; add top-position isometric 5–10s each rep on clusters.
- Core: Add hanging knee raise reps to 8–10; if ready, straight-leg raises partials 3x3–5.

Week 10
Session A
- Decline Push-up 7x3–5 (4–1–X)
- Squat 1.5 reps 5x6
- Archer Push-up Shift 4x5/side
- Hollow-to-Arch Rolls 3x8

Session B
- Pull-up Wave: 5 rounds of 1–2–3 assisted reps per round; rest 60s between steps, 2–3 min between rounds
- Feet-Elevated Doorway Row 5x8 (3–1–X); last rep 5s iso at top
- SL Hip Thrust 4x10/side (3–1–2)
- Hanging Knee Raise 4x8–10

Session C
- Pike HSPU (increase range if solid) 6x4 (3–1–X)
- Bulgarian Split Squat 5x6–8/side (3–1–2)
- Chin-up Eccentrics 4x2 (10s down)
- Pallof Press ISO 3x20–30s/side

Phase 4: Consolidation & Testing (Weeks 11–12)
Goal: Solidify, test simple benchmarks, set next progressions.

Week 11
Session A
- Push-up Benchmark Pyramid: Set a 10-min cap to complete 50 quality flat or decline push-ups in as few sets as possible. Record sets/reps.
- Squat: Tempo 4x10 (3–2–1)
- Hollow Hold 4x30–40s
- Optional: Archer shifts 3x4/side for skill

Session B
- Pull-up Benchmark: 20 assisted strict reps total in ≤10 min; options: EMOM 2 reps. Record assistance level and structure.
- Doorway Row Max-Quality Sets: 4 sets to RIR 2 (2 reps in reserve), 3–1–X tempo.
- SL Hip Thrust 3x12/side
- Hanging Knee Raise 3x10–12 or straight-leg partials 3x5

Session C
- Pike HSPU Density: 20 total reps in ≤12 min at chosen range. Record.
- Split Squat 4x10/side (2–1–2)
- Anti-rotation Plank with Reach 3x10/side
- Optional: Hollow Rocks 2x12–15

Week 12
- Taper volume slightly (80%) and test best single-set efforts with perfect form and no grinding:
  - Max quality flat push-ups (or decline if strong)
  - Best strict assisted pull-ups in one unbroken set (note assist)
  - Longest hollow hold
  - Longest active hang
- Sessions (keep structure, 3x/week):
  A
    - Push-up Practice 5xAMRAP to RIR 2 (stop 2 reps before failure), 90s rest
    - Squat 3x12 (smooth)
    - Hollow Hold 3xmax-10s buffer
  B
    - Assisted Pull-ups EMOM 1–3 reps x 10 min
    - Doorway Row 3x8–10 (3–1–X)
    - Hip Thrust 3x10/side
  C
    - Pike HSPU 5x3–5
    - Split Squat 3x8/side
    - Core of choice 2x

Optional Weekly Skill/Conditioning (10–15 min, 1x/week)
Rotate:
- EMOM 10: 1–3 assisted pull-ups + 5–8 push-ups
- 6–8 rounds: 20s hollow hold + 40s walk/rest
- Handstand kick-up practice to wall or pike holds: 5–8 sets of 20–30s
- 8 min alternating: bear crawl 20m + reverse lunges 10/side

Progression Rules
- When you can complete all sets at top of rep range with tempo and RIR ≥2, progress lever (harder variation), increase decline/elevation, extend isometrics, or add a set.
- If you fail early: keep the variation, reduce reps by 1 next set, extend rest, or deload next week by 20%.
- Maintain full ROM: chest-to-floor on push-ups, chin clearly over bar (assisted), thighs at least to parallel on squats.

Recovery
- Sleep: target 7–9 hours, consistent schedule.
- Daily mobility snack (5–7 min): thoracic openers, hip flexor stretch, calf/ankle rocks, wrist prep for pushing.
- Hangs on off days: 2x20–30s easy, optional.

Nutrition (general for strength and recovery)
- Protein: ~1.6–2.2 g/kg/day.
- Calories: slight surplus if goal is primary strength/muscle (maintenance if body comp priority). Adjust by +/–200–300 kcal based on weekly bodyweight trend and performance.
- Carbs around training: 30–60 g within 2 hours pre; 30–60 g within 2 hours post.
- Hydration: 30–35 ml/kg/day; add 500 ml around training.
- Creatine monohydrate: 3–5 g/day (optional), consistent timing.

Home/Equipment Tips
- Doorway pull-up bar: ensure secure fit. Use a sturdy chair for foot-assisted pull-ups; keep toes lightly on for just enough assist.
- Rows: loop a towel over bar for neutral/underhand grip variations; move feet forward to increase difficulty.
- Push-up scaling: stacks of books under chest to set depth and remove one book weekly; use couch for incline/decline.
- For added load later: fill backpack with books for squats, split squats, hip thrusts, and rows once bodyweight progressions are maximized (optional in final weeks).

Benchmarks to Track
- Push-ups: flat 20+ strict reps
- Assisted Pull-ups: progress to 3–5 strict reps with minimal assist and 20+ total in session
- Pike HSPU: 5+ clean reps at moderate range
- Hollow hold: 45–60s
- Active hang: 45–60s

This plan stays strict to the available tools, scales intelligently, and gives you week-by-week structure with clear progression levers. Adjust session days to the client’s schedule and use RIR to manage fatigue.
